reason: E1 shows AFSD can relieve residual stress in Al alloys, but only via post-process heat treatment, not during deposition. E2 supports mechanical alloying of AlCrFeNiSi but does not address AFSD or residual stress. E3 confirms residual stress is a problem in fusion AM but does not support AFSD as a solution. The core premise that AFSD inherently reduces stress during deposition is not directly supported by the cited evidence.
premises: AFSD can reduce residual stresses in aluminum alloys
AFSD can refine grain structure via severe plastic deformation
AlCrFeNiSi powder can be produced by mechanical alloying
Fusion-based AM causes high residual stresses in metals
